sources.summary: Toy brand Lego has unveiled an 8.4-metre-high replica of the World Cup trophy outside the Rockefeller Center in New York. Built from over a million bricks, the oversized World Cup was built at the fan park in Rockefeller Plaza for this year's tournament, which is being held in the USA, Mexico and Canada.
